records.text: Jeremy Boreing wrote Brett Cooper into Lady Ballers in a scene requiring her to lick his face, and she declined.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Writing a movie script like Lady Ballers and inserting Brett Cooper into a role to lick your face, which she declined to do, that feels a bit gratuitous to me for a conservative company.

verification.notes: The released Lady Ballers material provides production context, but no authenticated script draft, call sheet, or on-record participant account establishes that Boreing wrote a face-licking scene for Brett Cooper or that she declined it.
